P7531.corridor_notes: Main trunk of the 苏皖豫干线 (Su-Wan-Yu / Jiangsu-Anhui-Henan trunk) project, PipeChina Group. Per the MEE Nov-2025 EIA approval: '干线起自江苏省盐城市通榆分输清管站，止于河南省平顶山市鲁山东压气站' (starts at Tongyu Distribution & Pigging Station, Yancheng, Jiangsu; ends at Lushan East Compressor Station, Pingdingshan, Henan). Corridor crosses 14 prefecture-level cities across 3 provinces: Jiangsu (Yancheng, Lianyungang, Huai'an, Suqian, Xuzhou), Anhui (Huaibei, Suzhou, Bozhou, Fuyang), Henan (Zhoukou, Shangqiu, Zhumadian, Luohe, Pingdingshan). Length is cited two ways across sources: the earlier EIA public-participation notice (pipechina.com.cn) and a construction bid-award article (sohu) both give 796.6 km, matching GEM's LengthMergedKm exactly; the final Nov-2025 MEE approval gives 823.8 km / DN1219mm / 10 MPa design pressure / 18.3 bcm/y capacity for the as-approved main trunk — likely a pre-final-design vs. as-approved delta, not a routing error.

map_or_vector.desc: 1032-page full Environmental Impact Report (环境影响报告书) for the 苏皖豫干线项目（滨海-鲁山）, uploaded to doc88.com Sep 2025. Almost certainly contains detailed route maps for the whole network (main trunk + Xuzhou liaison + Sihong branch), but was not opened/traced for this deliverable — flagged for a human GIS pass if finer route geometry is wanted.

P7531.researcher_notes: High-confidence: both endpoints are named, specific facilities (distribution/pigging station and compressor station) confirmed identically across three independent Chinese-language sources (official MEE approval document, PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice, and a construction-bid news article), all giving the same start/end wording. Only the exact pipe length differs slightly (796.6 vs 823.8 km) between the pre-final EIA notice and the final Nov-2025 approval — not a location discrepancy.
P7531.blockers: Station-level coordinates are not resolvable in OpenStreetMap/Nominatim for either facility (both are recently-built PipeChina infrastructure, likely not yet mapped in OSM); used township centroid for the start (Tongyu Town) and county centroid for the end (Lushan County) as the finest available fallback. A human GIS pass against the full EIA report PDF (doc88 link above) could refine both to exact station coordinates.

P7532.corridor_notes: Xuzhou connecting/liaison line (徐州联络线) of the 苏皖豫干线 project. Per the MEE Nov-2025 EIA approval: '联络线起自干线睢宁分输站，止于江苏省徐州市徐州联络站，长87.33公里，管径508毫米' (starts at Suining Distribution Station on the main trunk, ends at Xuzhou Liaison Station in Xuzhou City; 87.33 km, DN508mm, 6.3 MPa). PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice and GEM both give 86.0 km for this segment (pre-final-design figure); the line runs entirely within Xuzhou prefecture, Jiangsu, connecting the main-trunk take-off point near Suining County to a liaison station in Xuzhou city proper.
P7532.researcher_notes: Matches GEM's StartLocation 'Suining' exactly (睢宁 Suining County, Xuzhou). Both endpoints confirmed identically by two independent official sources (MEE approval + PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice); a third source (bidding notice at caizhaowang.com) gives a slightly different length (86.7 km) for the same segment, consistent with pre-final-design variance rather than a different route.
P7532.blockers: Neither station name resolves in OSM/Nominatim directly; used county centroid (Suining) and city centroid (Xuzhou) as fallbacks. A human GIS pass against the full EIA report could refine to exact station coordinates.

P7533.corridor_notes: Sihong branch line (泗洪支干线) of the 苏皖豫干线 project, entirely within Suqian City (Sihong County), Jiangsu. Per the MEE Nov-2025 EIA approval: '支干线起自干线泗洪分输站，止于江苏省宿迁市泗洪末站，长26.62公里' (starts at Sihong Distribution Station on the main trunk, ends at Sihong End Station, Suqian; 26.62 km, DN323.9mm). PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice and GEM both give 28.5 km for this segment (pre-final-design figure).
P7533.researcher_notes: The branch's existence, start facility (泗洪分输站) and end facility (泗洪末站) are confirmed by two independent official sources with identical wording. GEM's pre-existing StartLocation field ('Sihong County Panshan Villege') plausibly refers to 潘山村 in 归仁镇 (Guiren Town) by romanization match, but I could not independently corroborate that the 泗洪分输站 facility sits in/near that specific village — treat the township-level start coordinate as a reasonable but unconfirmed refinement, not a source-verified fact.
P7533.blockers: Could not find any source tying 泗洪分输站 to 潘山村/归仁镇 specifically (searched '泗洪分输站 归仁镇' directly, no hits) — the village/township identification rests on name-matching against GEM's own prior field, not an independent citation. Neither station resolves directly in OSM/Nominatim.

P7534.corridor_notes: Same Jiangsu (start)-to-Henan (end) provinces as P7531, no distinct segment name, and no source found describing a fourth, physically distinct 913.8 km pipe in this network. Arithmetic match: GEM's own segment lengths for this family sum EXACTLY to 913.80 km — P7531 main trunk (796.60) + P7532 Xuzhou liaison line (86.00) + P7533 Sihong branch (28.50) + 2.7 km = 913.80. The 2.7 km residual matches the MEE approval's '互联互通管道 2.7公里' (interconnection pipelines) line item, a small facility-tie-in component not separately tracked as its own GEM PID. This is very strong evidence P7534 is an aggregate/total-project row (sum of the whole 苏皖豫干线 network's components as originally scoped), not a fifth, independently routable pipe.
P7534.researcher_notes: Recommend treating P7534 as a duplicate/aggregate of P7531 (+ P7532 + P7533 + the untracked 2.7km interconnects) rather than drawing an independent route for it — no source describes a distinct 913.8 km pipe segment separate from the already-itemized main trunk/liaison/branch family. Start/end fields above mirror P7531's sourced endpoints for continuity, not a newly-researched claim. Flagging duplicate_of=P7531 per task instructions; a human should confirm whether to retire/merge this PID in GEM rather than stage a route candidate for it.
P7534.blockers: No segment name or independent route description exists for this PID; resolution is a duplicate-identification, not a fresh endpoint finding, hence marked PARTIAL rather than ENDPOINTS despite having coordinates+refs (they are borrowed from P7531, not independently sourced for P7534 itself).

P7536.corridor_notes: 苏皖天然气管道联络线 (Jiangsu-Anhui gas pipeline connecting/liaison line), a SEPARATE, earlier project from the Nov-2025-approved 苏皖豫干线 main network (not mentioned in the MEE Nov-2025 approval) — under construction per GEM's Status field. Per Xuancheng municipal government's EIA public-participation notice: '起点为苏皖天然气管道两省交界处连接点（新杭镇板桥村），终点为拟新建的新杭输气枢纽站（S338国道南侧），线路全长约16.3Km，管径D610mm，设计压力6.3MPa' (starts at the Jiangsu-Anhui provincial-border connection point at Banqiao Village, Xinhang Town; ends at the proposed Xinhang Gas Transmission Hub Station, south of national/provincial road S338; ~16.3 km, DN610mm, 6.3 MPa). Built in Guangde City (广德市), Xuancheng (宣城市), Anhui. Route also crosses/near Xiahenggang, Dongcuo village, and Wufeng village, and provincial road S458, per related Guangde-government notices for the same project. Note: the source itself labels S338 inconsistently as '国道' (national road) even though S-prefixed roads are normally provincial (省道) in China's numbering — flagged, not resolved, matches GEM's 'S338 Provincial Road' EndLocation.
P7536.researcher_notes: Exact match to GEM's fields: StartLocation 'Banqiao Village' = 板桥村; EndLocation 'S338 Provincial Road' = the S338-adjacent proposed hub station; length 16.3 km matches GEM's LengthMergedKm exactly; province Anhui matches. Confirmed by the Xuancheng municipal government's own EIA public-participation notice (verbatim quote above), corroborated by a second, related Guangde-government EIA notice describing the same route through Banqiao/Xiahenggang/Dongcuo/Wufeng villages crossing S458 and S338.
P7536.blockers: Start and end are only ~16km apart and both resolve to the same Xinhang-town-level OSM centroid — Nominatim has no finer feature for either the border connection point or the proposed hub station, so the two endpoint coordinates in this file are identical even though they represent distinct points along the corridor. A human GIS pass against the Xuancheng/Guangde EIA notices (which name intermediate villages: Xiahenggang, Dongcuo, Wufeng) could differentiate start vs. end more precisely.
